what_the_body_says: SNU449: moderately high WWOX mRNA (Results) / high level (Methods). SNU387: essentially undetectable (Results) / low level (Methods). Of 11 HCC lines, 2 very low, 7 intermediate, 2 higher (Figure 1A legend); which lines are the two low and two high is in the figure, not in the text.
limit: SNU387 is the gain line, SNU449 the loss line. p53: SNU449 codon 161 Ala to Thr; SNU387 truncated at codon 164 (V03).

what_the_body_says: WWOX-EGFP fusion, WWOX cDNA 1,251 bp missing 13 C-terminal amino acids. Transient: nuclear condensation, vacuolisation, up to 95% cell death at 72 h, so high-expressing clones could not be selected. Two stable clones (WWOX1, WWOX3) after 12 to 16 weeks of G418 selection.
limit: The stable clones are survivors of a selection that kills most WWOX-expressing cells; their WWOX level is not given in the text beyond 'increased expression' (Figure 5D legend).

what_the_body_says: One shRNA sequence (single construct, pSS-H1p). SNU449 stable: 40% lower WWOX mRNA and 30% lower WWOX protein than vector. Figure 3A to 3C use transient transfection; which preparation (transient or stable) Figure 5E and 5F use is not stated in the text.
limit: No second shRNA, no rescue construct, no scrambled-shRNA control other than the empty vector.

what_the_body_says: One compound: the JNK inhibitor, written SP600129 in the text; the paper's reference 66 is the SP600125 paper (Bennett 2001). 25 uM for 6 h for the SNU387 clones (Figure 5A legend). No concentration or duration stated in the text for the SNU449 panels 5E and 5F, the proliferation panels or staurosporine and FGF2.
limit: No dose-response and no second chemotype described.

what_the_body_says: Apoptosis: DAPI staining with fluorescence microscopy (Methods; Figures 3B, 3C, 4C, 4E, 5A, 5B, 5E) and phase-contrast morphology (5A). Proliferation: cell counting, MTT, BrdU. n: no replicate number and no test named anywhere in the text; 'significantly' without a value; the only p value in the body is p < 0.01 for the splice-variant count.
limit: Whether a panel shows n or error bars is not read.

what_the_body_says: None for phospho-JNK or phospho-c-Jun. Phospho-ERK1/2, called downstream of JNK by the authors, in the gain line only: WWOX alone no significant change; inhibitor substantially inhibits phospho-ERK in vector cells; WWOX plus inhibitor inhibits further. Methods list a phospho-ERK antibody for the SNU449 shRNA blots; no SNU449 phospho-ERK result appears in Results.
limit: ERK phosphorylation is not a direct JNK-activity readout; the WWOX-JNK1 phosphorylation of WWOX (Tyr33, Tyr61) is cited in the Introduction, not measured (V23).

item: inhibitor alone on viability by WWOX status
what_the_body_says: Gain line: the inhibitor 'significantly enhanced' apoptosis in the WWOX clones (the text does not state the vector-plus-inhibitor against vector-plus-DMSO comparison) and 'further inhibits' proliferation in both vector and WWOX cells. Loss line: inhibitor-induced apoptosis significantly decreased with knockdown; the inhibitor reduced SNU449 proliferation to about 25% of control (the text does not say whether vector or knockdown cells) and did not completely abrogate the knockdown's proliferation gain. Baseline apoptosis is also lower with knockdown (Figure 3B, 3C) and higher with WWOX in the gain line, so the text does not separate an inhibitor-specific effect from the baseline.
limit: The paper's own wording 'enhances WWOX-induced apoptosis' (V26) describes the inhibitor as adding to an apoptosis that WWOX already causes.
